sheets.prompt:
Image 1 is a sticker of a small sea turtle. Draw this exact sea turtle as a cut-out paper puppet: its separate body parts laid out on one sheet, the same drawing style, colours, texture, line and proportions as in image 1, every part at the size it has in image 1.

Draw each part on its own, spread out over the sheet with wide empty gaps between them, no part touching or overlapping another:
1. the body: the rounded shell patterned in brown and green with its orange rim, and the soft cream underside just below it, as in image 1, without head and neck and without any flipper: no flippers drawn on it; where the neck comes out at the front of the shell, the shell's rim and the underside are drawn whole.
2. the head on its neck: the turtle's green spotted head with its neck, turned as in image 1, with a completely blank face — no eyes, no eyebrows, no mouth — keep the spots and the rosy cheeks; the end of the neck, normally under the shell, rounded.
3. one front flipper: the big near front flipper of image 1 (bottom left of the shell) drawn whole, green with its dark patches, from its rounded root to its tip, as in image 1.
4. one back flipper: the small back flipper of image 1 (at the left end of the shell) drawn whole, from its rounded root to its tip, as in image 1.

Every part is drawn whole, including what is normally hidden behind another part, and each joint end (where it tucks under the body or the head) is a full, smooth, rounded edge. No text, no labels, no numbers, no outline around the parts beyond the drawing's own line, no shadows. Fully transparent background.

Image 1 is a sticker of a small sea turtle; image 2 shows the same sea turtle cut into puppet parts, with a blank face. Draw the sea turtle's face pieces as separate stickers on one sheet: the same drawing style, colours and line as in image 1, every piece at the size it has on the sea turtle in image 1, so it fits the blank face in image 2.

Draw each piece on its own, spread out in tidy rows with wide empty gaps between them, nothing touching:
1. the turtle's right eye (the bigger eye, on the left of image 1): a big dark round eye with a white sparkle, as it is in image 1.
2. the same eye wide open and surprised: bigger and rounder, with its white sparkle.
3. the same eye gently closed in sleep: a soft downward-curving line with a few lashes.
4. the same eye closed in a happy smile: an upward-curving arc.
5. the same eye sad: looking down, its upper lid tilted up towards the middle, a thin shine of a welling tear along its bottom rim.
6. the same eye crying: gently squeezed shut, a soft downward-curving line (a sad closed eye, not a smile), a few small lashes, and one small light-blue teardrop just below its outer end.
7. the mouth as it is in image 1: a gentle closed smile, just the curved line.
8. the mouth wide open in a big happy laugh, the inside pink.
9. the mouth open in a small round 'o'.
10. the mouth in a small sad frown.
11. the mouth sobbing: a small open downturned frown with a little pink inside, trembling.
12. the mouth open in a big yawn, the inside pink.

No text, no labels, no numbers, no shadows, no face or head around the pieces. Fully transparent background.
